description.blurb: S/2003 J 16 was discovered in April 2003 by Brett J. Gladman at the Mauna Kea Observatory in Hawaii.
description.more: S/2003 J 16 is a member of the Ananke group. S/2003 J16 has a mean radius of about one kilometer (assuming an albedo of 0.04). At a mean distance of about 13 million miles (20.9 million kilometers) from Jupiter, it takes about 616 Earth days to complete one orbit.
